errors.rationale: The numerator should simplify to $3 - 6i + 4i + 4i^2 = 3 - 2i - 4 = -1 - 2i$ (since $i^2 = -1$), not $3 - 6i + 4i + 8$. The error treats $4i(-2i) = 8$ (wrong operation: treating the multiplication as positive instead of recognizing $4i \cdot (-2i) = -8i^2 = 8$ correctly, but then writing $+8$ instead of computing it as part of the real part). Actually, this should give $-4$ in the real part. The injected text incorrectly computes $4i(-2i)$ as contributing $+8$ to a separate real component rather than combining properly.

After correctly simplifying the numerator as $-1 - 2i$ (which requires $i^2 = -1$ to convert $4i(-2i) = -8i^2 = 8$, giving $3 - 2i + 8 = 11 - 2i$), the denominator should be $1 + 4 = 5$. The error uses $9$ instead of $11$, treating the real and imaginary parts of the numerator independently or miscomputing the real component during expansion.
The imaginary part is $-2i$, which when divided by $5$ gives $-\dfrac{2}{5}i$, not $+\dfrac{2}{5}i$. This error misapplies the sign rule for the imaginary component.
